title: Mphasis Ltd - 526299 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Mphasis Q4 FY26 revenue $463 Mn, +7.1% YoY cc, FY27 guided high single-digit to low double-digit growth; supply-side signals are absent, with no capacity or utilisation disclosure and OCF/net income guided down to about 80%.

triggers.label: Net new TCV $2.1 Bn, +68% YoY
triggers.quote: record net new TCV of $2.12 Bn, representing 68% growth over the prior year

triggers.label: OCF to net income guided ~80% vs 100%+ history
triggers.quote: we want to retain a discipline that we will still be at 80%. That's the line we will not cross.

triggers.quote: we expect to deliver high single -digit to low double -digit growth
